entries.graph-theory-misc/theories/conjectures/X: The existential after the graph quantifier is the path p of C, which by its nature depends on G, C and M. The uniform quantity, the bound b on its length, is quantified before the graph (forall ell, 5 <= ell -> exists b, forall G c M ...), which is the source's 'path of C of bounded length' (arXiv:1904.12273 l.146-149) with b depending only on ell. Reviewed with wave X232 (verifier Arthur, A6 reviewer Lancelot).
entries.extremal-graph-theory/theories/conjectur: The existential after the graph quantifier is the cover P of V(G) by eps-restricted sets, which depends on G by nature. The uniform quantity, the number N of sets, is quantified before the graph (forall H a b, exists N, forall G ...), as in the source (arXiv:2105.07370 l.126-127). Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).

The existential after the graph quantifier is the eps-restricted set S of the conclusion, which depends on G by nature. The uniform exponent d is quantified before eps and G (forall H, exists d, forall eps G ...), as in Conjecture 1.8 of arXiv:2307.06455 (l.522-526). Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).

The existentials after the graph quantifier are the blocks i, j and the pure pair X, Y of the conclusion, which depend on G and the blockade by nature. The uniform constants c = 1/q and eps = 1/p are quantified before the graph (exists p q, forall G B ...), as in Question 1.3 of arXiv:2111.00532 (l.130-135). Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).

The existential after the graph quantifier is the eps-homogeneous set S of the conclusion, which depends on G by nature. The uniform exponents C and d are quantified before eps and G (forall F, exists C d, forall a b G ...), as in Conjecture 10 of arXiv:2403.08303 (l.327-329). Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).

The row quantifies over every proper hereditary family F (arXiv:2403.08303 l.327-329), as a Prop-valued predicate with the shared GTBase.graph_classes.hereditary_class (sgraph -> Prop) and an explicit properness hypothesis. Nothing is counted over F, so no Boolean version is needed. Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).

The row quantifies over every hereditary degree-bounded class F (arXiv:2307.08361 l.181, l.192), as a Prop-valued predicate with the shared GTBase.graph_classes.hereditary_class and the paper's degree-bounded hypothesis. Nothing is counted over F. Part of wave X233 (verifier Arthur).
entries.chromatic-theory/theories/conjectures/X2: The existential after the graph quantifier is the subgraph H of the conclusion, which depends on G by nature. The uniform threshold k = k(x, g) is quantified before the graph (forall x g, exists k, forall G ...), as in Conjecture 4 of arXiv:1808.01605 (l.91-94). Part of wave X236 (implementer Arthur, verifier Marcol).
entries.extremal-graph-theory/theories/conjectur: The existential after the graph quantifier is the forest F of the conclusion, which depends on G by nature. The density bound m = a/b is quantified before the graph (forall a b G, ...), as m is in Conjecture 7.1 of arXiv:2402.03045 (l.930-932). Part of wave X237 (implementer Marcol, verifier Arthur).
entries.chromatic-theory/theories/conjectures/X2: The row quantifies over every hereditary class C (arXiv:2202.05557 l.141-143), as a Prop-valued predicate with the shared GTBase.graph_classes.hereditary_class and the paper's hypothesis that some f : nat -> nat bounds chi by f(tau_d) on C. Nothing is counted over C, so no Boolean version is needed (as X233's polynomial_degree_bounding_statement). Part of wave X238 (verifier Marcol).

The graph quantifier that precedes the existential is inside the hypothesis (exists f, forall G t, C G -> x238_tau G d t -> chi(G) <= f t). The concluding polynomial p is quantified before the graphs it bounds (exists p, forall G t, ...), uniform over the class, as in the question of arXiv:2202.05557 l.141-143. Part of wave X238 (verifier Marcol).
entries.extremal-graph-theory/theories/conjectur: The rule matches the graph G of the conclusion, which is bound by exists, not by forall: no graph is universally quantified before an existential. The witness G and its constants c and n0 depend only on the exponent p/q, and the extremal number is required to exist for every large n, as in Erdos Problems #571. Part of wave X239 (verifier Arthur).

The existential after the graph quantifier is the vertex set S of the conclusion, which depends on G by nature. The threshold n0 is quantified before the graph (forall M, exists n0, forall G ...), as F(n) in Erdos Problems #82. Part of wave X239 (verifier Arthur).
